notes.title: Rogue State Revolution Launch Trailer Reveal, Demo and Raptor!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/0QgmJWV/RSR-Steam-News-800x450-date-announc-and-demo.png[/img]

ROGUE STATE REVOLUTION arrives on your screen with a roar of impending cataclysm in this thirty-six-turn demo of the forthcoming game. That’s big! And yes, we’re rather thrilled, if not wholly over-excited, with how it’s turning out.

Let's show off this spanking new launch trailer with reveal date shall we?
[previewyoutube=35Iyim6cLu4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]GREAT! NOW WHAT'S IN THE DEMO?
[/h2]
The demo timeframe, represents three years of in-game playtime and it will teach you how to play, and then see how you deal with an impending giant meteor crisis! Can you save the Glorious People's Republic of Basenji from the fiery perils of space?

With this demo you get a chance to go hands-on with The Glorious People's Republic of Basenji. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/w6b5rP4/get-gif-on-steam-post.gif[/img]

[h2]GOOD GRIEF THERE'S MORE? 
[/h2]
But that's not all. Right now you can watch Rappack daddy Raptor as he streams a special preview build of the game and hopefully spot some useful tips that you can apply to your own runs or may suggest some to him in the chat.

[h1][b]Head over to the broadcast page to watch this live now.[/b][/h1]

[h2]GO PLAY THE DEMO RIGHT NOW[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145340/rogue_state_revolution/?utm_medium=social&utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=demoraptor

notes.title: Rogue State Revolution: Ministers, Roads and Insights
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/dkwTdSj/RSR-Steam-News-02-800x450.png[/img]


Good day to you Excellency,

It has been another glorious week for the People's Republic of Basenji and we are long overdue for another update on the essential features of Rogue State Revolution.

We are getting closer to making the release date for game public (very soon).  You're going to be the first to receive that intel report.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Vp0dkLN/Characters.png[/img]

[b]Meet the Minister: Aziz el Kamali[/b]

Aziz is a cunning man and while he offers the benefit of lowering construction costs for buildings that fall under his Ministry, the caveat to be aware of is that he may change policies you made to suit his own needs. And he won't leave a memo before doing so. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/SKyj22p/Minister-Aziz-el-Kamali.gif[/img]

As with all Ministers there's some take and give but placing him within your cabinet will result in some major savings over the course of the game.  If you can handle his [i]mercurial [/i]personality.  (He will straight-up poison you with mercury.  Be advised.)

[img]https://i.ibb.co/6vfB2VZ/Basenju-Insights.png[/img]

Speaking of Aziz el Kamali this week we're looking at roads. Doesn't sound that exciting unless you're a civil engineer but they are the first thing you must create in Basenji to connect varied points such as buildings and will be important to assess with regards to placement and their quality.

The Romans used roads as one long branded ink stamp across Europe because they were extra like that and hopefully you will facilitate the transportation needs of your people in a more civilized manner.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/MVP0x0N/RSR-road-1.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] How do you solve a problem like transporting the nations resources to be processed and distributed?
[*] How can we ensure trade routes with neighbouring countries?
[*] What exactly will a bipedal maniacal mech stomp upon?
[/list]

Ok the answer to the last point is "anywhere it damn well pleases" but for the rest it's roads. 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/0mLDfh6/Behind-the-State.png[/img]

We have a special treat this week as we share exclusive footage of the FMV cast doing some of their scenes. Your advisors Sabriyah Altaf and Yusef Kouri are played by Sam Smilovic and Karim Bayoumi respectively.


[previewyoutube=kBvgPmHpS5s;full][/previewyoutube]


Thanks again for coming along to this weeks update. If you want to discuss any aspects of the games development or story you can join in here or the following hubs:

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/modernwolf]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Rogue State Update 1.36
notes.content:
And here comes another update for Rogue State, which rebalances some parts of the gameplay. Most importantly, the effects of taxes have been revised. Setting the taxes very high or very low now has more consequences than before. In addition to that we fixed a number of small bugs in the treasury calculations and policy effects, and a few minor graphical glitches have been fixed too.

Thanks for all your feedback! It's been 10 months since we have released this game, and it's been quite a journey. Thanks to your comments and suggestions the game has grown considerably bigger, better and more enjoyable.

    [*]Fixed some expenses and income not appearing the the treasury window.

    [*]New mouse speed settings in the setup program.
[/list] 

Have fun, and thanks for playing! :-)

notes.title: Rogue State 1.30 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
we've just released another major update!
Rogue State 1.30 comes with the following changes:
[list]
[*]A series of Russian themed events. If your relations with the US aren't too good, this might be an interesting alternative. It's a risky path, but it can get you great benefits in the late game.
[*]Many new events that have been suggested by the community.
[*]More ways to counteract unemployment.
[*]Special projects can now be cancelled manually.
[*]Bugfix: Prevent Steam from overriding Achievements that got unlocked while the Steam servers were down.
[*]Bugfix: Ongoing costs not updated correctly after a special project was stopped.
[*]Some other minor bugs have been fixed.
[/list] 
WARNING: Rogue State 1.30 is not compatible with old savegames. If you want to continue your old games, you can still play the previous version by opting into the old_1.27 branch (Open the Steam client, right-click on Rogue State -> Properties -> betas) 

We hope you all enjoy the new version. Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: Next Major Update Underway
notes.content:
Happy new year, everybody!
We have some news for you: We're currently working on another update (1.30) that will include many new events suggested by the community. 
A lot of people asked for it, so there will also be a branch of events involving Russia, which will give you new ways to approach your foreign relations - annoying the USA might finally pay off.

The update is planned to be released later this week. It will be incompatible with saved games from previous versions, so Rogue State 1.27 will remain available for those who want to finish their old games.

- "Referendum" story branch: A rare bug where the referendum results were never displayed, and the game would just run out without a proper ending.

- Yesterday I accidently uploaded a broken build of 1.27 that crashed at the end of a speech. This is now fixed.

notes.title: Rogue State 1.20 released!
notes.content:
The big update is finally there! We've been listening to your feedback and implemented many new features. Here are some of the highlights:
[list]
[*]An [b]Endless Mode[/b] that doesn't have the Farouk storyline. That doesn't mean this mode is less challenging, as there are still plenty of ways to screw up.
[*]A new [b]Easy Mode[/b] where you start with more money, better approval ratings, and the results of events are less punishing.
[*][b]Hard Mode[/b] now lasts one year longer than the standard game.
[*]Unlockable Scenarios can be combined with these new modes. Want to play "Capitalist Playground" in Endless Mode? Now you can.
[*]Loyalty points above 100 aren't lost - you can now spend them on nice benefits.
[*]Many GUI improvements, tooltips and explanations.
[*]Two new policies: education and mass transit.
[*]Many minor changes to improve the gameplay balance.
[/list] 
WARNING: Rogue State 1.20 is not compatible with old savegames. If you want to continue your old games, you can still play the previous version by opting into the [i]old_1.13[/i] branch (Open the Steam client, right-click on Rogue State -> Properties -> betas)

We hope you'll enjoy the new version. Thanks for all your constructive feedback - you helped us make Rogue State a better game!

notes.title: Opt-In 1.20 Beta
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've finished work on a major update to Rogue State that is available now as an opt-in beta for anyone that wants to try it out (right-click, Properties, betas).

[b]Warning:[/b] Rogue State 1.20 isn't compatible with saved games from previous versions. Old saved games can't be loaded in the new version.

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

- New gameplay modes!  Endless mode has no Farouk, and continues on forever unless your loyalty reaches zero.  Easy mode is...well...easier than the base game.  Hard mode lasts for six years, rather than five, and has the usual ramped up difficulty of the previous "nightmare mode".  These modes can now be combined with any scenarios you've unlocked.
- Loyalty points in excess of 100 are stored in a "loyalty bank" and can be redeemed from the Parliament menu for benefits.
- Policy effects now have hard limits.  Gone are the days of boosting support for a quarter of the game and then coasting for the rest.
- Policy window redesign, with clearer linkages between policies and their effects.
- Two new policies: mass-transit and education.
- Two new events!
- Murders of Cabinet ministers are now less common.
- Counterfeiting currency gives smaller rewards, smaller likelihood of detection and pays out even when detected (40m/33%).
- Clicking on the dog's nose now brings up the cheat GUI.  Cheat-codes disable highscores and achievements.  "makeitrain" gives $200m and "assumecontrol" gives 20 LP.
- Tooltips on the treasury, your regional projects and your Cabinet ministers now let you know exactly what you're getting into.
- Very high education and very low corruption improves UN relations.
- Allowed the game to start without a family name.
- Added a bit of randomness to npc attack/defence values.
- Enemies at war with another NPC now (usually) have a reduced defence value.
- Highlighting factions in policy menu displays what policies and policy effects affect them.
- Severe tax changes now improve or devastate employment and GDP.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

- Actions now should always update your treasury funds, including printing currency and having your bailout money repaid.
- Fixed policy slider mouseovers not appearing in some cases.
- Fixed Necromancy: Assassinated leaders could still phone calls.
- Fixed wrong npc IDs when animating relationship bars.
- Fixed rounding errors in quest benchmarks.
- Meteor strikes no longer break the game if you need to rebuild intelligence or a hotel.
- Oil pipeline now calculate correctly.
- New unlockables and highscores are no longer overridden when loading an old saved game.
- Fixed possible crash when loading a wrong VoiceMode variable.
- Fixed division by zero crash when tourism = 0.
- Fixed "attack npc" quests.
- Fixed quest_complete variables not getting reset to false when the quest is over.
- Export revenue quest disabled until turn 5.
- Death penalty now calculates effects correctly.

notes.title: Major Update Underway
notes.content:
We've enjoyed both the positive feedback and constructive criticism we've received over the past few days.  We're going to keep tightening the bolts on Rogue State, and you can anticipate a lot of your suggestions being adopted over the next few days.

New features will break savegames, so we'll give a bit of warning before 1.2 comes out.  We will be building an open beta branch for any community members brave enough to test the new gameplay elements.

We're just two guys trying to make a game about the kinds of countries that games don't really get made about -- thank you for your patience, your wisdom and for spreading the word about the Glorious People's Republic of Basenji.

notes.title: Rogue State 1.10
notes.content:
And here comes another update!
In addition to minor bug fixes, this update re-balances parts of the gameplay and the score calculations. This also means that we have a new leaderboard for Rogue State 1.10+
Your old saved games will still work with this version. But if you want to keep playing play the previous version, you can use the Steam client to opt into the "old_1.03" branch.

These are the most important changes in Rogue State 1.10:

- War casualties: You're no longer going to lose countless of units if you launch a strong attack.
- If your approval levels are very high, this also affects minister loyalty
- Likewise for very low approval ratings.
- Final score calculation has been changed. Most importantly, the offshore bank account doesn't yield as many points as it used to, while the survival bonus has been increased.
